Speech therapy also bumps it (solver).

neighbours.label: Weak, dense hum (gate-closed leak of the + pole) that is stronger on mental-health treatment by meaning, not by the word 'therapy': psychotherapy, psychiatry, counselling, ECT, psychiatric diagnosis (psychiatrist/psychologist sentences fire without 'therapy'; 'retail therapy' stays quiet; physical/speech therapy bump it partly). Narrow side branch: title-case ' Late' in 'Too ... Late' headlines ('Is It Too Late?' ~0.4, 'Too Little, Too Late' ~0.3), while lowercase 'too late' in prose stays at the hum (~0.14). The mapped feeders (L5/N4199+ 'too ADJ to', L0 故/遮 characters) do not lift ordinary too-late prose.
